title.hi: ग्रामीण छात्र प्रोत्साहन एवं शिक्षण सामग्री वितरण

description.en: An assembly recognizing hardworking village students facing economic hardship, providing notebooks, stationery kits, and education grants.
description.hi: मेधावी व जरूरतमंद ग्रामीण छात्र-छात्राओं को अभ्यास पुस्तिकाएं, पाठ्य सामग्री और अध्ययन प्रोत्साहन सहयोग।

summary: An assembly recognizing hardworking village students facing economic hardship, providing notebooks, stationery kits, and education grants.
